Daily Den privacy

Saved games

Unruled, WireWise, and CropWeave save your progress, statistics, and settings in your browser. WireWise and CropWeave also keep recent playtest events locally. Clearing Daily Den’s site data clears those records.

Homepage analytics

When enabled, Daily Den counts homepage visits, game tile clicks, and Sponsor, Contact, and Privacy clicks. A random ID stored in your browser is converted into a different identifier each Pacific calendar day to count repeat visits on that day. Daily Den records the referring website’s hostname or a recognized game name. It does not record full referrer URLs, IP addresses, email addresses, or game answers in the analytics database. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track disable homepage analytics.

Site hosting and gameplay analytics

Cloudflare may process request information, such as IP addresses, to serve and protect the site. Daily Den’s gameplay analytics are off by default.

When enabled, Unruled uses a randomly generated browser ID to record gameplay events such as visits, puzzle starts and completions, attempts, hint use, reveals, and sharing. Gameplay analytics do not store your name, email address, submitted answers, or full referrer URL. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track disable gameplay analytics.

When enabled, CropWeave sends batches of limited events, including puzzle starts, completion scores and timing, tip use and sharing. It does not send tile placements or player identifiers. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track disable these events.

CropWeave’s activity dashboard counts visits, first tile placements, completed daily farms, scores, and selected button and share actions. It stores a hash of a random browser ID to count returning players. The dashboard does not record tile placements, full URLs, IP addresses, names, or email addresses. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track disable this collection.

Feedback

If you email us, we receive your email address and the details you choose to share. We use that information to review and respond to your message.

Games on other sites

Lineup.Day opens on a separate site and has its own privacy page.
